**Provider name and URL**

**Does the provider's Terms of Service permit browser automation of its web
UI for a signed-in user's own account?**
(Link to the relevant ToS section if possible. Requests that require
bypassing ToS, CAPTCHAs, or rate limits will not be accepted.)

**Conversation URL pattern**
e.g. `https://example.com/chat/:id`

**How can AI Flow verify it has the correct conversation open?**
(URL pattern, page title, a visible conversation id, etc.)

**How can AI Flow detect usage-limit / auth-required states?**
Describe any visible text or UI state that reliably indicates these states.
Screenshots help.

**Attachment support**
Does the provider's compose UI support file/image attachments? How?
